title: Редактирование выбросов
semantics: Detect outliers in selected continuous numeric fields using parameters.outlier: fields, method sd/iqr, explicit outlier_factor/extreme_factor and ordered. Train current input before Execute; keep/keep retains original values. Read all three ports: 0 all rows, 1 outliers excluding extremes, 2 extremes. New nodes require all five settings; existing patches preserve omitted settings. Editing policies, quality, variables and saved-model apply are unsupported. STAGE0 PROPOSAL ONLY: editing, quality and saved-model apply have not been observed in LAB-1018 because the UI session disconnected twice. The mathematical expected files are hypotheses, not established native rules. Do not implement these modes until discovery and owner approval.

fields.description: Complete continuous numeric field names; retain unlisted fields.

method.description: SD about mean or IQR fences.

ordered.description: Input already ordered; does not sort.

outlier_policy.description: Proposed per-class native editing action; convention and side-output behavior await observation.

outlier_constant.description: Proposed replacement only when the matching policy is constant; finite number.
